scripts.build: npm run build -w @skyteam/shared && npm run build -w @skyteam/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @skyteam/shared" "npm run dev -w @skyteam/server" "npm run dev -w @skyteam/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @skyteam/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @skyteam/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && tsx scripts/test-rules.mjs && tsx scripts/test-units.mjs && tsx scripts/test-bot.mjs
